tickets.title: Dual-format hook output emission for forward compatibility (#943)
tickets.body:
GitHub Issue: https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc/issues/943

=== CONTEXT ===
plugins/adlc-gemini/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs and adlc-rails-guard.cjs currently emit { allow_tool: false, deny_reason: '...' } or { allow_tool: true }. Antigravity's latest customization spec documents { decision: 'deny' | 'allow', reason: '...' }. Emitting both key sets simultaneously ensures forward and backward compatibility across all current and future versions of agy CLI and Antigravity IDE.

=== TASK ===
1. Update allow() and deny() in plugins/adlc-gemini/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs to emit dual-keyed objects:
   - allow: { decision: 'allow', allow_tool: true }
   - deny: { decision: 'deny', allow_tool: false, reason: '...', deny_reason: '...' }
2. Update failSafe() in plugins/adlc-gemini/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.cjs to emit the dual-keyed format.
3. Update plugins/adlc-gemini/test/decide.test.mjs, test/wire.test.mjs, and test/flail.test.mjs to assert that decision, reason, allow_tool, and deny_reason are correctly populated.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: allow() returns { decision: 'allow', allow_tool: true }.
- AC2: deny() returns { decision: 'deny', allow_tool: false, reason: <reason>, deny_reason: <reason> }.
- AC3: All tests pass under node --test plugins/adlc-gemini/test/*.test.mjs.

tickets.title: Implement PreInvocation ephemeral context injection (active ticket & frozen rails) (#940)
tickets.body:
GitHub Issue: https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc/issues/940

=== CONTEXT ===
Antigravity supports the PreInvocation lifecycle hook event in hooks.json. It receives system metadata and outputs { injectSteps: [{ ephemeralMessage: '...' }] }. This allows injecting the active ticket, declared scope, and frozen rails as an ephemeral reminder before each model turn, eliminating the need to manually invoke /adlc-status.

=== TASK ===
1. In plugins/adlc-gemini/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs, export a preInvocation(payload, { env }) function that inspects the active ticket via resolveActiveTicketId() / railPreconditions().
2. When an active ticket is present, return { injectSteps: [{ ephemeralMessage: `[ADLC Context] Active Ticket: ${active.id} | Scope: ${scope.join(', ')} | Frozen Rails: ${rails.join(', ')}` }] }. When inactive or no ticket, return { injectSteps: [] }.
3. Wire the PreInvocation event in plugins/adlc-gemini/hooks.json pointing to adlc-rails-guard.cjs preinvocation.
4. Update plugins/adlc-gemini/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.cjs to support process.argv[2] === 'preinvocation'.
5. Add tests in plugins/adlc-gemini/test/context-injection.test.mjs.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: preInvocation outputs ephemeralMessage when active ticket is present.
- AC2: preInvocation outputs empty injectSteps when no active ticket is present.
- AC3: hooks.json declares PreInvocation handler.
- AC4: node --test plugins/adlc-gemini/test/*.test.mjs passes.

tickets.title: Wire Stop lifecycle hook to intercept unverified completion claims (#941)
tickets.body:
GitHub Issue: https://github.com/voodootikigod/adlc/issues/941

=== CONTEXT ===
Premature satisfaction (F1) is a primary model failure mode. Antigravity supports the Stop hook in hooks.json. Returning { decision: 'continue', reason: '...' } blocks agent termination and forces continuation.

=== TASK ===
1. In plugins/adlc-gemini/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.mjs, export a onStop(payload, { env }) function.
2. When ADLC_P4_ENFORCEMENT=1 and an active ticket is present:
   - Check if the session transcript ends with completion without verification.
   - If unverified, return { decision: 'continue', reason: 'ADLC Rails-Guard: Active ticket build requires running test/verification commands before completing.' }.
   - Otherwise, return { decision: 'stop' }.
3. Wire the Stop event in plugins/adlc-gemini/hooks.json.
4. Update plugins/adlc-gemini/hooks/adlc-rails-guard.cjs to dispatch 'stop' subcommand.
5. Add tests in plugins/adlc-gemini/test/stop-hook.test.mjs.

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: onStop returns decision: continue when completion claimed without running verification under enforcement.
- AC2: onStop returns decision: stop when enforcement is inactive or verification ran.
- AC3: node --test plugins/adlc-gemini/test/*.test.mjs passes.
